"$100,000 paid to $BNKR stakers in two weeks."

We read Bankr's staking contract. The $100K is real: 124.97M and 121.01M BNKR from Bankr's 1/3 fee Safe on Sep 29 and Oct 6, $99,762 at each day's price.

So who earns it?

The largest staker is Bankr's 2/3 fee Safe. Bankr's own API lists it as a fee claimant, and the staking contract names it as its pending owner.

As of Oct 6 it held 13.3% of all stake, 3.29B BNKR, and had earned 13.1% of rewards streamed so far: 18.0M BNKR, unclaimed.

Where 28.85% comes from: when the post went up, staked BNKR earned 25.42% a year. Restaked weekly, the method Bankr's own agent uses for APY, that's 28.857%. It checks out.

Stake and reward are both BNKR, so price doesn't move the rate. Funding and total stake do.

"30% of launch revenue buys $BNKR": from Sep 1 to 28 the 1/3 Safe got 29.7% of Bankr's fees.

By Sep 29 it held 1.38B BNKR, via a Relay fill from Robinhood Chain, swaps and its own LP. It has paid 246M to stakers and held 1.30B, about $506K, at the end of Oct 6.

861 addresses stake. The top 10 hold 45.6%. By end of Oct 6, $53.5K had streamed and $15.2K had been claimed. The rest streams until Oct 13.

About 87% of each funding goes to the 860 other addresses, 13% to Bankr's Safe.
